blocks.content:
• FCI established in 1965.
• Created under Food Corporations Act, 1964.
• Procures at MSP but does NOT decide MSP.
• Maintains buffer stock.
• Key agency for PDS and NFSA.
Procures at MSP but does NOT decide MSP.

items: Frequent Trap: Examiners often trick candidates by stating FCI fixes MSP. FCI only procures at MSP; it does NOT determine it.
Year Differentiation: Note that the Food Corporations Act was passed in 1964, but FCI was officially established in 1965.
Key Implementation Agency: FCI is directly linked as the execution body for both PDS and NFSA.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: FCI was established in 1965 under the statutory framework of the Food Corporations Act, 1964.
While FCI procures food grains at the Minimum Support Price (MSP), it does not have the authority to decide the MSP.
FCI is responsible for maintaining the nation's buffer stock of food grains.
It serves as the main operational agency for implementing the Public Distribution System (PDS) and the National Food Security Act (NFSA).
